note: Append-only. Records are never edited to change a result; a changed outcome requires a new record with 'supersedes'. PHASE-03 was APPROVED by the User on 2026-10-03. The agent implemented the work but did not approve it; approval was recorded only from the user's explicit instruction.

records.expected: All control-model files exist and every required concept is detectable
records.actual: Sections 1-3 reported PASS: 5 control files exist; 16 concept checks passed (lifecycle stages DISCOVERY/DELIVERED, four truths DECLARED/IMPLEMENTED/VERIFIED/USER_APPROVED, AUTOMATED verifier class, DESTRUCTIVE action class, CRITICAL risk level, rollback_verified, APPROVAL_GATE, HARD_GATE, MISSING_USER_DECISION, MATERIAL_DECISION, append-only, ENFORCED); 5 schema contract checks passed; handoff fields next_allowed_action and forbidden_next_action present.

records.expected: Requirement contract file is valid JSON with 10 requirements
records.actual: Valid JSON. requirements: 10 (REQ-P03-01..REQ-P03-10), verifications: 6 (VER-P03-001..006). All 10 validated against the requirement contract: PASS 'satisfies the requirement contract'.

records.expected: A requirement with missing or non-observable acceptance criteria must be REJECTED
records.actual: CASE A REJECTED: 'acceptance_criteria is empty (MISSING_REQUIREMENT)'. CASE A2 REJECTED: 'acceptance criteria are not observable' for the criterion 'Build a good homepage'.

records.expected: Approval attributed to an agent, or with no decider, must be REJECTED
records.actual: CASE E REJECTED: 'APPROVED attributed to agent/model, not a user' for approval_decided_by='agent'. CASE E2 REJECTED: 'APPROVED but approval_decided_by is empty'.

records.expected: Implemented-without-evidence, verified-without-approval, and blocked-but-approved must all be REJECTED
records.actual: CASE B REJECTED: 'VERIFIED but no verification_refs'. CASE C REJECTED: 'CRITICAL verified but approval not received (PENDING_APPROVAL)'. CASE D REJECTED: 'blocker(s) [FAILED_TEST] present yet marked APPROVED - progression blocked'.

records.expected: Evidence tampered after a failed verification must be DETECTED
records.actual: CASE F DETECTED all three tamper signals in a single fixture: 'duplicate evidence IDs: [EV-P03-900]', 'invalid result enum: [EV-P03-901]', 'PASS without actual output: [EV-P03-900]'. Suite reported '8 cases correctly rejected, 0 missed'.

records.expected: Phase 02 governance controls must remain green after Phase 03 changes
records.actual: SPS lint: '== SPS lint PASSED =='. Governance validator: '== GOVERNANCE VALID: 48 checks passed, 0 failed ==', exit 0.

records.command: git diff --name-only HEAD -- skills/ scripts/ plugins/ .github/ install.sh uninstall.sh get-sps.sh README.md CHANGELOG.md
records.expected: No application, skill, installer or CI file may be modified in Phase 03
records.actual: Empty diff. Scope discipline section of validate-control.sh also asserted 'untouched (out of scope)' for auth-helper.ts, SKILL.md and install.sh.

records.expected: No machine-global configuration change and only .sps/ files modified
records.actual: Global config unchanged by this agent (a global identity created externally earlier is recorded as DISC-07 and was left untouched). Modified files limited to .sps/ control, requirements, evidence, handoff, schema and tooling paths.

records.expected: The Phase 02 validator must accept a legitimately-awaiting phase without false failure
records.actual: DEFECT FOUND: validator reported 3 FAILs. Root causes: (1) the approval enum did not include AWAITING_USER_APPROVAL - the exact state name the Phase 02 brief mandates in section 28; (2) the decision-resolution rule was implicitly Phase-02-specific and rejected DEC-0003/DEC-0004 as unresolved. Both fixed: enum extended, rule scoped so a decision raised inside an awaiting phase may legitimately be pending. Re-run: GOVERNANCE VALID 49/49, exit 0.

records.expected: All three validators pass together with zero source changes
records.actual: SPS lint PASSED (exit 0); governance 49/49 exit 0; control 49/49 plus 8 negative cases exit 0. Source scope check: 0 files changed under skills/ scripts/ plugins/ .github/ or any installer.

records.command: record user approval of PHASE-03 in STATE.md, DEC-0003, DEC-0004, tasks, handoff, requirements
records.expected: Record the user's EXPLICIT approval with attribution, date and basis; do not infer it
records.actual: Approval recorded as genuine user approval on 2026-10-03 with basis 'Phase 03 implementation and verification were independently reviewed and accepted'. Updated: STATE.md (phase status APPROVED, Approval/Approved by/Approval basis/Approved rows, phase inventory, Approval Record table); DEC-0003 and DEC-0004 (PENDING -> APPROVED, Decided by: User); all 10 requirements (approval_status APPROVED, approval_decided_by User, approved_at, approval_basis); PHASE-03-TASKS.md (header + 6 task approval cells); HANDOFF-CURRENT.md (CURRENT_STATE, USER_APPROVAL, FORBIDDEN_NEXT_ACTION rationale); audits/README.md. PHASE-04 remains NOT_STARTED / NOT_APPROVED - approval was not carried forward.

records.expected: All validators and the negative suite pass after the approval transition
records.actual: SPS lint PASSED (exit 0). Governance validator: 50/50, exit 0 - the count rose from 49 because STATE.md is now APPROVED, which activates the per-record user-attribution branch across all 4 decision records. Control validator: 49/49 plus 8 negative cases (CASE A-F), exit 0.

records.command: negative test of the approval transition: (T1) attribute DEC-0003 to an agent; (T2) set a requirement's approval_decided_by to 'agent'; (T3) strip User attribution from DEC-0004
records.expected: A fabricated or unattributed approval must be rejected after the transition
records.actual: All three REJECTED, exit 1: T1 'DEC-0003 is APPROVED but not attributed to the User'; T2 'REQ-P03-01: APPROVED attributed to agent/model, not a user'; T3 'DEC-0004 is APPROVED but not attributed to the User'. All files restored from backup afterwards; both validators returned to exit 0.
